english: Dealing Grenade Damage to a Glyphkeeper grants 20%|25%|35%|40%|40% increased damage for 15 seconds with Pulse Rifles, Sidearms, Machine Guns, and Submachine Guns.

source.text:
Upon dealing Grenade Damage to a Glyphkeeper:

20% | 25% | 35% | 40% | 40% increased damage for 15 seconds.

Applicable Weapons:
 Pulse Rifles, Sidearms, Machine Guns, Submachine Guns.
